interpretation_limits: The generic label 菜葉 does not establish the botanical species or region-to-item binding.
Confidence scores are model output fields, not calibrated proof of food identity or nutrition accuracy.
The USDA reference badge is not evidence of a live USDA API request.
Displayed nutrients are database references scaled by vision-estimated weights, not measured ground truth.
The screenshots do not reveal raw request/response, model provider, model call count, retry count, token usage, or cost.
The screenshots do not reveal whether profile or meal-record writes occurred.

visible_ui_findings.finding: Header badge is hard-coded to Gemini + TFDA although the matched chicken card is labeled USDA reference; this neither describes all matched sources nor proves the model provider.
The heading says 2 recognized foods while five additional recognized-but-unmatched foods are listed below; it counted nutrition matches, not all detected candidates.

changes.source_badge: Now summarizes sources from matched detections and does not guess the model provider.
changes.partial_scan_title: Now says how many nutrition profiles were matched.
changes.candidate_count: The result count includes pending detections; partial states use a warning icon.
